salesLanguage.headline: APO-VX20-UC-V2: improves the meeting experience for people in and outside the room
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the room needs to support video meetings, shared audio, cameras, microphones or BYOM/BYOD collaboration.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It helps make the meeting feel joined-up: people can be seen, heard and shared with more reliably than using loose laptop accessories.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Huddle rooms, boardrooms, classrooms and hybrid meeting spaces.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Ask what the remote participant needs to see and hear, then position the product around that experience.
talkTrack: It is about the meeting workflow, not only the hardware.
It helps remove friction around camera, microphone, speaker and USB connectivity.
It should be selected when conferencing is part of the use case.
discoveryPrompts: Which meeting platform is being used?
Do users bring their own laptop, use a room PC, or both?
What camera, microphone and speaker coverage does the room need?
positioningNotes: Use for UC-led rooms where audio, camera or USB device behaviour matters.
avoidPositioningAs: Do not lead with UC products for simple video switching if there is no conferencing requirement.

technicalLines: USB-C IN: Supports DP video transmission, maximum resolution: 4K@30Hz
Auto Framing / Speaker Tracking / Presenter Tracking / Individuals Gallery / Manual Mode
8 x Linear microphone arrays with AEC, ANS, and AGC | Pick-up Range: 8m/26.2ft
Button, Bluetooth Remote Controller, API, Web UI
Supports up to 4K@30 video resolution on a HDMI input, 4K@60 video resolution on a HDMI output 1 and, 4K@30 on HDMI output 2, ensuring superior visual quality for your presentations
Features automatic switching modes such as last-in-first-out, ensuring the most relevant input source is always displayed
Supports USB-C video transmission and 60W source charging
Includes enhanced Acoustic Echo Cancelation, background noise reduction, automatic gain control, and full duplex mode communication to make all participants feel like they are in the same room
Built in 8x MEMS digital mic arrays with a range of 8 Meters, an angle of 180 degrees and microphone range extension with up to 5 APO-SKY-MIC’s
Supports firmware updates via the Web UI and offers multiple methods to restore factory settings, ensuring the device stays up-to-date and easy to troubleshoot
Two LED lights to show the working status, one for camera and one for system
Plug & Play, and full compatibility for OS (Windows 10 or above Mac OS 10.15 or above) and UC applications, like Zoom, Teams, etc.
Compatible with Microsoft Teams Rooms(MTR), like Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2 devices.
